risks.note: MD&A Risks and Concerns states that availability of cotton, the main raw material for cotton yarn, is subject to the vagaries of nature and that prices fluctuate wildly based on supply/demand in the world market and government policies. The Directors' Report adds that cotton prices have increased sharply from April 2026 onwards, so the FY27 input-cost base is already rising.

MD&A states the prices of man-made fibres depend on the prices of crude and are hence subject to volatility — a live exposure now that polyester-cotton blended yarn production has been commenced and is being widened.
risks.risk: Man-made fibre prices tied to crude

risks.note: MD&A states that fluctuations in duty regimes directly influence landed costs and that evolving tariff structures are prompting manufacturers and brands to revisit supplier mix, consider nearshoring and adopt automated compliance processes. The Directors' Report separately names tariff-related measures by the USA as a negative.
risks.risk: Evolving tariff structures and duty regimes

risks.note: The Directors' Report lists the outbreak of wars causing geopolitical tensions among the negatives, and says the FY26 improvement in performance was achieved in spite of uncertainties on account of tariff-related issues and war-driven geopolitical tension.

Home Textiles made-ups such as bed linen are stated to be meant mainly for exports and the segment is a declared focus area, while yarn, woven fabric and knitted fabric also carry export sales — so the tariff, FTA and duty-regime exposures above bear directly on a growing share of the business.
risks.risk: Export dependence, concentrated in home textiles

risks.note: Knitted fabric, woven fabric and processing-division output are all stated to be produced against orders, with surplus processing capacity utilised for job work — leaving utilisation of these units dependent on order flow rather than on the Company's own scheduling.
risks.risk: Order-driven production across fabric, knitting and processing

risks.note: All disclosed manufacturing (spinning near Dindigul, weaving and home textiles at Karanampettai, processing at SIPCOT Perundurai, knitting near Dindigul) and all captive wind and solar generation are located in Tamil Nadu, and all activity sits within one cotton-textile value chain, giving no geographic or sectoral diversification against the raw-material and demand shocks above.

The Practising Company Secretary's Corporate Governance certificate carries an exception — a time lag between the Board's appointment and the members' approval constituted a technical non-compliance with Regulation 17(1A) of SEBI (LODR) in respect of the appointment of a non-executive independent director who is over 75 years of age.
